user.title: Connect to your Codie
user.description: Enter the address of your Codie. You can find its IP address in your router. The Codie must be awake and signed in.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the Codie.
data_description.port: The port of the Codie's local API. Leave at 8081 unless you changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with your Codie again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer sign in to the Codie at {host}. This happens when another user signs in on the Codie, or its pairing was reset. Select Submit to make the Codie show a new pairing code.

pair.title: Pair with your Codie
pair.description: Your Codie is now showing a six-digit pairing code. Enter it below. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

data_description.code: The six-digit code shown on the Codie's screen.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Codie. Check the host and port, and that the Codie is awake.
error.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the code on the Codie and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while pairing. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Codie is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Codie. Check the host and port, and that the Codie is awake.
abort.code_expired: The pairing code expired or was already used. Start again to get a new code.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error while pairing. See the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.reauth_successful: Pairing worked again. The Codie is back online.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different Codie from the one that was set up. Check the host, or add it as a new Codie.
abort.not_signed_in: No user is signed in on the Codie. Sign in on the device, then try again.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Makes the Character speak a message.

message.name: Message
message.description: What the Character says, word for word. Up to 16000 characters.

queue.name: Queue
queue.description: Wait until the Character is idle, then speak the message and save it to its chat history. Up to 200 characters. Leave off to speak at once, cutting off whatever the Character is doing.

announcement_length.message: The message must have between 1 and {max} characters.

codie_target_missing.message: Choose a Codie as the target: add a target and pick the Codie device or its Announce entity.

codie_not_loaded.message: That Codie is not loaded. Check its status on the Codie integration page.

announce_blocked.message: The Codie cannot speak right now ({reason}). It may be asleep or locked; wake it first.

announce_cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Codie. Check that it is awake and on the network.

announce_auth_failed.message: The Codie no longer accepts Home Assistant. Pair it again from the integration page.

announce_not_ready.message: The Codie's speech service is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.

setting_cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Codie. Check that it is awake and on the network.

setting_auth_failed.message: The Codie no longer accepts Home Assistant. Pair it again from the integration page.

setting_not_confirmed.message: The Codie received the change but could not confirm it: {error}

setting_music_volume_failed.message: The Codie could not set the Music volume: {error}

music_command_failed.message: The Codie could not run the music command: {error}

music_command_not_confirmed.message: The Codie received the music command but did not confirm it ran: {error}

music_mode_inactive.message: The Codie is not in Music mode. Open its music player on the Codie first; only the volume works without it.
